review.title: Inspect an operation and its repository diff

pixel_review.reviewer: Codex /root/ux_audit/audit_recovery; direct PNG view_image and paired terminal JSON; no Firefox
pixel_review.summary: Readable operation graph with distinct selected current-operation row, complete operation IDs and action summaries. Long captured setup argv lines clip at the right edge of the 104-column viewport; this is faithfully recorded product content, not a capture defect. Footer and caption remain separate and legible.

text_style_review.reviewer: Codex /root/ux_audit/audit_recovery; direct PNG view_image and paired terminal JSON; no Firefox
text_style_review.summary: Paired 104x36 state matches the PNG. Eleven styles distinguish blue operation IDs, green workspace/current marker, yellow identity, teal time and magenta argv. The selected ID is 9c2455ad07e9; candidate bookmark creation is visible. Long argv strings are clipped in the terminal state too. This successful log capture does not test UX-08 failure.

pixel_review.reviewer: Codex /root/ux_audit/audit_recovery; direct PNG view_image and paired terminal JSON; no Firefox

text_style_review.reviewer: Codex /root/ux_audit/audit_recovery; direct PNG view_image and paired terminal JSON; no Firefox

text_style_review.reviewer: Codex /root/ux_audit/audit_recovery; direct PNG view_image and paired terminal JSON; no Firefox

pixel_review.summary: Returns to a clean repository graph with candidate working copy, four change descriptions and root visible. Selected-row marker is distinct; caption accurately says return without undo. No modal or clipped operative graph identity.

The retained inspection assertions report unchanged working-copy commit and unchanged visible repository graph. This verifies return without mutation, not Undo/Redo.

video_review.reviewer: Codex /root/ux_audit/audit_recovery; ffprobe, source tape timing, and sampled ffmpeg contact sheet
video_review.summary: Sampled review, not a real-time watch: ffprobe reports 15.866667 seconds, 238 frames at 15 fps. Inspected a 16-frame contact sheet including exact first/last frames, evenly spaced by frame number, against source.tape. The 14 seconds of explicit visible holds (four 2.5-second checkpoints plus two 2-second waits), 70ms typing and transitions agree with the duration. Samples show clean graph opening, operation log, show, candidate search, diff, refreshed log, then an uninterrupted final graph hold; no visible fixture setup or cleanup. Captions remain outside content and the sequence has readable 2–2.5-second holds. Operation output clips long metadata lines as UX-15; the video faithfully records that product limitation.
